description: The athlete's track & speed workout library, with paces set from current fitness. The coach uses this to prescribe variety in track sessions. Rotate sessions week to week; pick 2 per week (3 only once recovery and fuelling are solid).
paces_intro: Training paces from CURRENT fitness (recent 10k ~4:09/km, half ~4:16/km, VO2max 58). Goal paces (5k 3:34, HM 3:45) are faster — shift reps toward them as fitness sharpens.

workouts.name: 10 x 400m @ 5k pace
workouts.note: Classic 5k/VO2 session. Start at 8 reps if fatigued.

workouts.name: 6 x 4 min @ 10k pace
workouts.note: Aerobic power by effort — forgiving on tired legs.

workouts.name: (800m @ 10k + 200m @ 5k) x 7
workouts.note: 'Float' session — big aerobic stimulus, very race-specific.

workouts.name: 5 x 120m @ 90% effort
workouts.detail: Hard but relaxed, walk back to recover.
workouts.note: Pure speed/strides — low stress, tack onto an easy day.

workouts.name: (800 / 400 / 200m @ Zone 4) x 2
workouts.note: Descending ladder by heart rate — good when GPS pace is noisy.

workouts.name: (300 / 200 / 300m @ Zone 4) x 2
workouts.detail: 100-200m jog float + 2 min rest; 5 min between sets.
workouts.note: Short, sharp Z4 reps with floats.

workouts.name: 6-8 x 800-1200m @ 10k pace
workouts.note: Threshold-to-10k engine builder; grow reps over weeks.

workouts.name: (3km @ HM + 1km @ Marathon) x 4
workouts.note: Long-run quality — can replace the long run as a 3rd hard day.

workouts.name: 3k tempo + 2k threshold + 5x400 @ 5k + 5x200 hard
workouts.note: Full mixed session — only when fresh and well-fuelled.
